CLIENT PROJECT / 2025

Aurentum Jewellery

Everyday luxury, without choosing sides.

Brand identity · Packaging
THE STORY

A world of
its own.

The idea

Aurentum celebrates the harmony of gold and silver through contemporary two-tone jewellery. The brief called for an identity that balances timeless elegance with an approachable, everyday feel.

The design

Refined serif typography, a custom A-based monogram and a considered palette bring the idea of duality to life. Premium packaging carries that same quiet confidence into the unboxing experience.
